title: Panasonic MultiShape ER-CKL1-A Beard & Hair Trimmer

comparisons.notes: Panasonic US store MultiShape Beard & Hair Trimmer Starter Kit with 2 combs (1-20mm), variant SKU ER-CKL1-A, barcode 885170399259, in stock.

writeup: The Panasonic MultiShape ER-CKL1-A beard and hair trimmer starter kit is $28.11 new at Woot, while Panasonic's own store sells the same SKU for $85. It comes with two combs covering 1 to 20mm, and Woot shows only 3 left with a limit of 3 per customer, so this one may not last long.
